# Nikos Amofa

> Application analyst and cybersecurity practitioner. Founder of Watusoft Solutions, a Microsoft 365 security advisory for small and mid-sized law firms in NJ and NY.

Nikos Amofa works as an Application Analyst at one of the world's largest law firms, focused on vendor risk reviews of AI platforms, access governance, and M365 security operations. He holds ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, and CompTIA PenTest+, and is pursuing a Master's degree at WGU alongside CISM certification.

He writes The Operator's Notebook, a monthly newsletter covering cybersecurity lessons from inside an enterprise environment and transparent updates on building Watusoft Solutions.

## Business

- [Watusoft Solutions](https://watusoft.com): M365 security audits and hardening for small and mid-sized law firms in NJ and NY. ABA Rule 1.6 aligned, cyber-insurance ready. 5–10 day engagements starting at $2,500.
